notes.title: Next update preview
notes.content:
Currently, the reading rewards in the narrative system seem too plain, so I have decided to redesign a reward mechanism for the narrative system
However, since I need to prepare for the computer science graduate exams, the update and internal testing process might be a bit slow
I have decided to set aside some time each week to push forward the development of this game
Players of the demo version, I apologize, but the update pace will be slightly slower than that of the official version
Of course, if there is anything unsatisfactory about the current game content, feel free to bring it up
As for the game price, currently the overall progress of the game has not yet reached what I had hoped for; at the very least, the narrative and monster AI are not diverse enough, but in the future, with continuous improvements in the narrative and monster AI, the game price will see an increase. I cannot determine exactly when this will happen, because my personal time is quite limited

notes.title: 2025 Update Announcement
notes.content:
However, due to the author needing to pursue graduate studies, the update frequency for 2025 may slow down. If the author returns to development, an announcement will be made as soon as possible.
If you encounter any bugs in the game, feel free to leave a message in the comments section.
If you think the game looks interesting and would like to experience ongoing updates and improvements, please click "Add to Wishlist".
The game is currently being sold at the lowest price. In the future, as the game adds more content such as storylines, worldviews, maps, types of monsters and bosses, weapon varieties, and character passive skills, the price of the game may be appropriately increased.
